blocks.x: Upstream and downstream operators run hazardous physics under volatile markets: predictive integrity, energy efficiency, trading precision and OT security decide both margin and license to operate. Every program must respect process-safety culture from day one.

The workflows we industrialize here: Integrity management, Turnaround scheduling, Trading and scheduling, Emissions monitoring, Process optimization. Each arrives with its current cycle times measured in the Diagnose phase, and each leaves the program governed by outcome SLOs rather than anecdotes.

items: Pipelines, separators and rotating equipment hold failure precursors nobody sees; integrity runs on schedules.
Convergence and legacy SCADA create attack paths with physical consequence; 62443 incomplete.
APC setpoints static while feedstock shifts; energy and yield losses accepted.
Intraday opportunities missed; scheduling/bidding on spreadsheets.
Emissions data assembled by estimate; auditors and buyers demand measurement.
Turnaround and maintenance scheduling combinatorial; downtime too long.

blocks.x: How we help — five priority capabilities

items: corrosion/vibration/thermal telemetry on critical assets — failures predicted
62443 zoning with monitoring and access control — attack paths closed
ML-augmented APC with constraint awareness — yield/energy up
market data + positions into scheduling/bidding — P&L up
scheduling formulations across solvers — downtime down
